title: McpToolContext
description: The `_context` object every MCP tool call carries: who is calling, on behalf of which tenant, and what they may do. Language-neutral form of the TypeScript `McpToolContext` type and the `contextSchema` Zod validator; signers in other languages mint the signed-context token from the same fields.

tenant_id.description: The tenant (organisation) the call is scoped to.

user_id.description: The end user the call is made on behalf of.

user_email.description: Optional display/lookup email for the user. Informational; never an authorization input.

role_name.description: The user's role within the tenant, e.g. owner, admin, tech.

request_id.description: Correlation id for logs; echoed as `rid` in the signed token.

scopes.description: Row-level visibility limits (which company/property/unit the user may see). Empty or absent means the role decides.

fieldwork_entity.description: The entity type `scope_ref_id` refers to in the field-service system of record.

credentials.description: Runtime API material forwarded to the server (delegated OAuth tokens, app passwords, allowlists). String values only. Carried unsigned EXCEPT the SIGNED_CREDENTIAL_KEYS, which are accepted only from the signed token under enforcement.

_token.description: Signed-context JWT (EdDSA or HS256) over the authorization fields above. Required when the server enforces signatures; its presence alone confers no trust.
